messages:
Anika: Quick pre-meeting note — agenda for today's hosted API planning sync. Need a short can/should/won't list for the next quarter. Top asks: embeddings latency SLA (Acme Health), chat streaming reliability, rerank throughput + batching, and per-model billing breakdown. Please react with priorities and call out blockers.

Sam: P1 for me is streaming reliability. We're still seeing intermittent dropouts when many clients hold open streams; likely KV-cache thrash. I can scope a staged fix + canary but need time.

Marta: Acme Health is pushing hard for embeddings 95th <= 180ms for short queries. They want a formal deadline by end of quarter. That target is aggressive for CPU-backed quantized models.

Jeff: If we ship a 4-bit quantized variant we can reduce latency/cost, but we need a perf/quality eval. Also, we should add `model_version` to the request so customers can pin variants without changing client logic.

Liz: For rerank customers, the ask is a batched scoring endpoint. Mobile clients can't batch easily today; exposing `batch_size` and a simple client-side helper would help adoption. Low-risk change but API surface needs careful docs.

Anika: Quick poll: include per-model billing breakdown in Q3 (MVP) or push to Q4? This is low-dev but high-analytics effort. @Jeff?

Jeff: Q3 MVP is doable — 7-day retention, per-route costs only. Full per-token model attribution can be Q4.

Marta: Blocker: we don't have the capacity reserved in eu-west-1 for Dedicated customers. Eng-Infra estimates 2w to provision racks and infra. That affects Acme's compliance timeline.

Sam: I'll take streaming fix + canary. Need a perf harness and the `stream-stress` script tuned. Can someone add a perf job? @deploy-bot can you book a canary window for me?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-07-15 18:00 UTC (2h window). Notifying: @Sam @Marta @Jeff @Liz.

Anika: Rollout acceptance criteria (MVP):
```
- Streaming P95 drop rate < 0.1% under 75th perc. concurrency
- No increase in token latency > 10ms median for other routes
- Canary run for 2h with live traffic mirror and smoke tests green
```

Liz: For rerank batching API, propose default `batch_size=8`, `max_wait_ms=50` in the SDK helper. Will draft openapi snippet and example clients.

Jeff: I'll own quantization eval — will run quality regressions vs. baseline on our eval suite by EOW. If regressions > 2% we hold.

Marta: I'll push Acme for a soft deadline extension to end of next month and offer dedicated capacity as a temporary SLA.

Anika: Action items: Sam — streaming canary + perf harness; Jeff — quant eval + API contract for model_version; Marta — customer negotiation & infra ETA; Liz — rerank batching spec & openapi. Sync Friday 10:00am for sign-offs. React with :thumbsup: if aligned.

Sam: :thumbsup:
